items.title: Bill Dobbins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: which was Miles’ band with Ron Carter and Tony Williams and Herbie Hancock and all of that

ctx.x: You know I had a similar experience at SUNY Fredonia in the music department. There was no jazz so to speak, but it was all student initiative. But there was something fantastic about that, that we were driven. We thought we were special.

Well I often tell students now, I think that the greatest benefit is that, even actually when we went into the school before we even decided to try to develop this program, all the students that I could remember were my peers and my best friends at the time, we were so proactive — I guess maybe, I don’t know if any of it had to do with the general social activism that was happening at the time — it was the period of the Civil Rights struggle and the Vietnam war and all of that. But my friends and I, if there was…
So your education in jazz was mostly your own initiative?
